name: 04_token_bucket_burst_throttle_refill
description: Edge-local admission gate, capacity 3 refilling 1 token/sec, starting full at t=0. A burst of 3 admits empties it, the 4th is denied (the mid-window 429 the daily-quota price cannot stop). Half a second later still < 1 token ⇒ denied; at t=1.0 exactly one token has refilled ⇒ admitted; immediately denied again. Deterministic injected time → identical decisions on both cores.
